title: Close Encounters contains a visual reference to Project Serpo

tellings.quote: >> And by the way, whether you believe it or not, put that aside, there's a whole kind of visual reference to Project Serpo in there,

plain: The 1977 Steven Spielberg film Close Encounters of the Third Kind, whose climax takes place at Devils Tower in Wyoming, contains a visual reference to Project Serpo. Serpo is a story about a supposed secret exchange programme in which US personnel were sent to an alien world. The writer Bryce Zabel says this to Michels: "whether you believe it or not, put that aside, there's a whole kind of visual reference to Project Serpo in there." If he is right, the film would have nodded to the Serpo tale decades before it became public.
